Job Description

Data Science Intern Co-op

Production machine learning models are only as good as the platform keeping them healthy, and we need someone who wants to build the internal tools, observability, and debugging systems that keep our models reliable in production.

What You'll Be Doing

Working alongside data scientists, ML engineers, and data engineers under the guidance of the Senior Manager of Data Science, you will build and ship the developer tools and observability systems that keep our production machine learning models running reliably. You will spend your days writing clean Python and SQL on AWS, tracking pipeline health and data quality, and flagging performance anomalies before they ever reach our partners. AI-assisted diagnostics and failure summarization tools accelerate how you trace pipeline bugs, leaving you with more room to design robust monitoring solutions and test their impact directly with the team. Before your term ends, the utilities and dashboards you deliver will be in the hands of the data science team, serving as part of their daily production workflow.

The Stack

Python



-  SQL
-  PyTorch
-  scikit-learn
-  AWS (SageMaker, S3, CloudWatch)
-  Git

What You Bring



- You are currently enrolled in a university co-op program in computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, or a related quantitative discipline, with an active work term available.
- You write clean, functional Python and SQL, with coursework or project experience in machine learning and frameworks like PyTorch or scikit-learn, backed by disciplined Git habits.
- You have a relentless curiosity for getting under the hood of systems to figure out why pipelines break, with an active interest in MLOps, model observability, and cloud platforms like AWS.
- You explain technical findings clearly and concisely, translating complex failure root causes, data discrepancies, and platform metrics into insights that technical and non-technical stakeholders easily understand.
- When it comes to AI, you have already built workflows or tools using LLMs to write code, automate repetitive tasks, or analyze data, pairing fast generation with the sharp judgment needed to catch hallucinations and verify results before shipping.

Why Plusgrade

Travel is about the moments that make a journey feel personal. At Plusgrade, we build the technology that makes those moments possible, from upgrade offers and loyalty experiences to revenue tools used by 575+ airline, hospitality, cruise, rail, and financial services partners worldwide.

The work is global, complex, and rewarding. You will solve meaningful problems, take ownership from idea to outcome, and work alongside people who are smart, curious, and committed to doing great work.

We also give our teams access to AI tools and the encouragement to use them thoughtfully, to move faster, explore ideas, and build better ways of working.

We trust our teams to do their best work. That means autonomy, flexibility, and room to grow.

Come help us shape the future of travel.

Job Description

UI/UX Design & Frontend Engineer Intern

Our internal teams spend all day configuring and onboarding partners through complex tools built without dedicated design, and we need someone who wants to untangle those dense interfaces and actually ship the production code to fix them.

What You'll Be Doing

You will take internal tools from rough problem statements and user interviews directly into production-ready React code, transforming dense forms and tables into clear, intuitive workflows. Working alongside a mentor in Applied AI Engineering, you will own the full cycle by researching friction points with teammates, auditing screens for accessibility, and shipping reusable components that other teams will adopt. AI-assisted design and prototyping tools handle the heavy lifting during early exploration, so you can spend your time validating interactions with users and refining edge cases. Your work will ship to live users throughout your term, giving you direct ownership over interfaces that power partner operations every day.

The Stack

React



-  Python
-  TypeScript
-  JavaScript
-  HTML
-  CSS

- You are currently enrolled in an accredited co-op program in design, computer science, software engineering, or human-computer interaction, with a work term available.

- You are comfortable diving into an unfamiliar codebase to write clean React, HTML, and CSS, turning design ideas into responsive, accessible interfaces that hold up under real use.
- You talk comfortably with teammates using your tools to test assumptions through lightweight research, and you actively welcome critique to push your work forward.

Job Description

Applied AI Engineer Intern (Co-op)

Our real-time inference services power machine learning across the entire business under strict latency SLAs, and we need someone who wants to take models out of notebooks and ship production Python services that scale.

What You'll Be Doing

Working closely with a senior mentor, you will build and operate the production inference services that serve machine learning models across our partner ecosystem in real time. Your day to day centers on writing clean, low-latency Python services with FastAPI, configuring cloud infrastructure on AWS, and building the pipelines and caching layers that keep response times fast under strict SLAs. You will use AI-assisted development tools to explore solutions and build prototypes faster, pairing rapid code generation with the engineering judgment needed to audit and refine the output before it reaches production. Every piece of code you write, from endpoint logic to integration tests, goes directly toward supporting live systems that real partners rely on every second.

The Stack

Python



-  FastAPI
-  AWS (SageMaker, EKS, ECR, S3, EC2)
-  Kinesis
-  Firehose
-  ElastiCache
-  Git
-  Splunk
-  Kafka
-  Helm
-  Terraform
-  Terragrunt

What You Bring



- You dive into unfamiliar codebases and complex architectures without hesitation, quickly figuring out how systems connect and becoming productive on live services in short order.
- You write clean, readable Python and understand how to build web services with frameworks like FastAPI, with a solid grasp of model inference logic, input and output contracts, and latency constraints.
- You treat testing as an integral part of development rather than an afterthought, writing thorough unit and integration tests to ensure that every pull request protects production stability.
- You are comfortable with version control and terminal workflows, and you are eager to get your hands dirty with cloud infrastructure like AWS, containerized deployments, and streaming or caching components.

Company Information

PACCAR is a global technology leader in the design, manufacture and customer support of high-quality light-, medium- and heavy-duty trucks under the Kenworth, Peterbilt and DAF nameplates. PACCAR also designs and manufactures advanced power trains, provides financial services and information technology, and distributes truck parts related to its principal business.

Peterbilt Motors Company

On highways, construction sites, city streets, logging roads - everywhere our customers earn their living - Peterbilt's red oval is a familiar symbol of performance, reliability and pride. Peterbilt has reigned as America's premium quality truck manufacturer since the company's founding in 1939. Our dedication to deliver products and services focused on improving customers' performance, image, profitability and peace of mind truly makes Peterbilt the Class of the Industry.

Requisition Summary

Peterbilt Motors Company, a PACCAR Company, has an opening for a Data Engineer Intern to add to our Advanced Analytics team in Denton, Texas.

Job Responsibilities

This position will be working on various projects and reports to include but not limited to:



- Design and implement reporting and analytics features in collaboration with product owners, data analysts, and business partners within an Agile/Scrum methodology.
- Design and implement AI vision solutions for image-based data processing and analytics.
- Proactively support product health by building solutions that are automated, scalable, and sustainable – be relentlessly focused on minimizing defects and technical debt.
- Provide post-implementation production support for data pipelines.
- Work closely with the business stakeholders and end users to plan, develop, and implement projects.
- Build and support automated data pipelines from a wide range of data sources using an AWS and Qlik Replicate-based technology stack with an emphasis on automation and scale.
- Orchestrate complex job sequences across technology stacks using Apache Airflow and other scheduling mechanisms.
- Contribute to overall architecture, framework, and design patterns to store and process high data volumes.
- Develop solutions to measure, improve, and monitor data quality based on business requirements.

Required Qualifications

The candidate we seek will be currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Informatics, or a related program.

Preferred Qualifications

The qualifications that are important to be successful in this position are as follows:



- Basic proficiency with SQL and Python for data manipulation, query writing, and script development
- Experience participating in highly collaborative, multi-disciplinary team environments on complex projects
- Demonstrated knowledge and hands-on experience with reporting tools such as Tableau or Power BI
- Understanding of Generative AI models, their applications, and practical implications in business contexts
- Exceptional proficiency with Microsoft Office suite
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills for presenting findings to diverse stakeholders
- Strong ability to multitask and prioritize competing deadlines effectively
- Self-starter mentality with resourcefulness and independent problem-solving capabilities
- Strong professionalism and commitment to high-quality, ethical work standards
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and draw actionable insights
- Interest in collecting, analyzing, and reporting to drive data-informed decisions

General Description Of Internship Benefits

As a U.S. PACCAR intern, you have a full range of benefit options including:



- Competitive salary and 401k with up to a 5% company match
- Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family
- Paid holidays
- Flexible spending accounts (FSA) and health savings account (HSA)
- Life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
- EAP services including wellness plans, estate planning, financial counseling and more
- Global Fortune 500 company with a wide array of growth, training, and development opportunities
- Work alongside experienced goal-oriented colleagues recognized as experts in their field
- This position may offer stipend assistance benefits

Additional Job Board Information

PACCAR is an E-Verify & Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veteran/Disability corporation. Peterbilt promotes Diversity and Inclusion through mentorship, events, and affinity support groups – The Diversity Council, Peterbilt Women’s Initiative (PBWIN), Veterans Group, Peterbilt Black Organization for Leadership and Development (B.O.L.D) and Peterbilt+ (An LGBTQ support group).
fit_why: Data engineering pipelines; Airflow/AWS/Qlik, candidate has SQL/Python

Position : Software Engineering Intern (Year-Round)     

 Location: A uburn Hills, MI   

 About us    

 BorgWarner is a global product leader in delivering innovative and sustainable mobility solutions for the vehicle market. We are a company of innovators and independent thinkers that   brings   together talented employees, meaningful   work,   and amazing technology in a unique environment. At BorgWarner we constantly work towards our vision of a clean and energy-efficient world.    

 Our Culture    

 We believe   health   and safety of our employees are   a top   priority ,   we care about our local communities and the global environment. BorgWarner promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive environment, honors integrity, strives for excellence,   commits to   responsibility for our communities and the environment, and builds on the power of collaboration .     

 Career Opportunities    

 We manage talent as seriously as we manage our businesses and encourage you to learn about our proud history, strong culture,   technologies   and future vision. We offer a strong local presence and interesting global opportunities. Start your future with BorgWarner now!   

 Job purpose   

 We are looking for a student to   assist   the Software Engineering team in the development of embedded software for drivetrain systems, such as transfer cases. The student will experience each phase of the software development cycle while working with engineers to design, develop, and test embedded software. There are also opportunities to experience the impact of our software and controls across the bench, dynamometer, and vehicle environments. In addition, the student will gain a greater perspective of the requirements, architecture, integration, and testing at the software level.   

 Key responsibilities   

• Create tools and scripts to   assist   in software development   

• Develop and execute test cases to verify software   

• Automate various processes and tasks   

• Assist   with software   component   creation process   

• Design and build test bench setups   

• Collect and   analyze   data from simulations and in vehicl e   

 What   we’re   looking for   

• Current full-time enrollment in an accredited college, university, vocational/trade school.  

• Ability to report onsite at least three days to our Auburn Hills Campus 

• EE, CE, or CS student interested in embedded software   

• Basic understanding of vehicle communication protocols   

• Capable of writing and debugging scripts   

• Experience with   Matlab   and Simulink   

• Strong writing and communication skills   

• Excellent organization and time management skills   

 What we   believe   

• Inclusion -We value diversity in people, ideas, and experiences.    

• Integrity - We believe in transparency, authenticity ,   and depend on each other to deliver what we promise.    

•   Excellence - We contribute to our developments by seeking knowledge and sharing information.    

•   Responsibility - We care about our local communities and the global environment.    

• Collaboration -   We are one BorgWarner .   

 Safety    

 This position will adhere to   Global   Star Safety Program, including safety rules, practices and training as outlined in the BorgWarner PTC Safety Policy Manual, which includes the use of equipment, protective devices, or clothing   that the employer   requires . This individual will work in manners that stress the importance of preventing accidents and illnesses. He/she must take every   precaution reasonable   in the given circumstance for the protection of themselves and coworkers. In addition, he/she   is responsible for   reporting all injuries and/or possible dangerous situations, incidents, or occurrences to the immediate supervisor.   

 Equal Employment Opportunity    

 BorgWarner is an equal employment opportunity employer such that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.   

 Visa Sponsorship    

 BorgWarner does provide sponsorship for employment visa status based on business   need . However, for this role, applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.   

 No Unauthorized Referrals from Recruiters & Vendors    

 Please note that BorgWarner and any of its affiliated companies   does   not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or offers from third party recruiters or staffing agencies associated with any published or unpublished employment opportunities. Any unsolicited information sent to BorgWarner will be   considered as   unencumbered and free from any fee or charge whatsoever. Only members of our Human Resources Team have the authority to engage or authorize recruiting services, which must be agreed upon before the unsolicited resume or offer is received.   

 Join the company that is creating solutions that support a cleaner, more energy-efficient world.   

 For more information about   BorgWarner, please visit   www.borgwarner.com
